environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed via hardened container image (ECR) with a custom AppArmor profile loaded via Lambda Extension layer. The profile (docproc-confined) is applied at container init and enforces: deny read/write on paths outside {/tmp/workflow_state/**, /var/task/**, /opt/**}. Specifically, the profile includes 'deny /var/cache/** rwklx,' and 'deny /etc/** rwklx,' rules with no exceptions. The profile also sets 'file /** -> deny' as default with explicit allow-list. Note: the AppArmor profile is compiled and cached in the Lambda layer at /opt/apparmor.d/docproc-confined and loaded by the extension bootstrap. The Lambda Extension (arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:layer:apparmor-enforcer:7) calls aa-exec to confine the runtime process. Additionally, the Step Functions state machine definition uses InputPath and Parameters with static JSONPath expressions that only pass $.document_id and $.content fields, dropping any injected cache_path from external input.
